# Local EnviroTox input

Place the EnviroTox Advanced Search export used for the optional audit workflow here as:

```text
envirotox_raw_export.xlsx
```

The expected search settings are documented in:

```text
documentation/envirotox_search.md
```

This raw export is intentionally ignored by Git and is not redistributed in the public repository.

The core analytical pipeline does not require this file.
